references.description: Whoever does any act with the intention of thereby causing hurt to any person, or with the knowledge that he is likely thereby to cause hurt to any person, and does thereby cause hurt to any person, is said voluntarily to cause hurt.

source.citation: The Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023 (Act 45 of 2023), section 115

references.offence_name: Rash driving or riding on a public way
references.description: Whoever drives any vehicle, or rides, on any public way in a manner so rash or negligent as to endanger human life, or to be likely to cause hurt or injury to any other person, shall be punished.
required_elements: driving or riding vehicle on a public way
manner so rash or negligent as to endanger human life or likely to cause hurt

source.publisher: Ministry of Law and Justice, India Code
source.citation: The Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023 (Act 45 of 2023), section 281

references.description: Whoever causes the death of any person by doing any rash or negligent act not amounting to culpable homicide, shall be punished with imprisonment.
required_elements: rash or negligent act causing the death
act does not amount to culpable homicide

source.publisher: Ministry of Law and Justice, India Code
source.citation: The Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023 (Act 45 of 2023), section 106

references.offence_name: Act endangering life or personal safety of others
references.description: Whoever does any act so rashly or negligently as to endanger human life or the personal safety of others, shall be punished.
required_elements: endangering human life or personal safety of others

source.publisher: Ministry of Law and Justice, India Code
source.citation: The Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023 (Act 45 of 2023), section 125

references.description: Whoever with intent to cause, or knowing that he is likely to cause, wrongful loss or damage to the public or to any person, causes the destruction of any property, or any such change in any property or in the situation thereof as destroys or diminishes its value or utility, or affects it injuriously, commits mischief.
required_elements: intent or knowledge to cause wrongful loss or damage
destruction or diminishment in value/utility of property

source.publisher: Ministry of Law and Justice, India Code
source.citation: The Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023 (Act 45 of 2023), section 324

references.offence_name: Report of police officer on completion of investigation
references.description: Every investigation under this Chapter shall be completed without unnecessary delay. As soon as it is completed, the officer in charge of the police station shall forward to a Magistrate empowered to take cognizance of the offence on a police report, a report in the form prescribed.
required_elements: submission of final report to competent Magistrate

source.publisher: Ministry of Law and Justice, India Code
source.citation: The Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (Act 46 of 2023), section 193

references.offence_name: Admissibility of electronic records in evidence
references.description: Any information contained in an electronic record which is printed on a paper, stored, recorded or copied in optical or magnetic media shall be deemed to be also a document, and shall be admissible in any proceedings.
required_elements: certification or chain of custody of device output

source.publisher: Ministry of Law and Justice, India Code
source.citation: The Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam, 2023 (Act 47 of 2023), section 63
